description.value: A family-owned Chinese restaurant in Kamloops' Aberdeen neighbourhood, widely regarded as the city's top choice for Chinese take-out. Moon Wok uses fresh ingredients with no MSG added and caters to a range of dietary needs including vegetarian, allergy-conscious, and gluten-free diners. Take-out, dine-in, delivery, and catering are all available at this South Shore location.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Moon Wok is an active, multi-location Chinese restaurant; the OSM phone (+1-778-471-3889) matches the 'South Shore: 778-471-3889' number listed on moonwok.ca, confirming this record is the Aberdeen/South Shore location. Takeout, dine-in, delivery, and catering are explicitly stated on the website, and vegetarian options plus a gluten-free menu are directly mentioned. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears in either the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: moonwok.ca is a multi-location site; individual location addresses are not listed per-page, so the OSM address (1820 Rogers Place) could not be confirmed via website content. Phone number match (South Shore: 778-471-3889) corroborates this is the correct location.
The licensed dining room and semi-private event space mentioned on the website are explicitly stated to be at the North Shore location, not this Aberdeen/South Shore location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Chinese restaurant with an active website and confirmed take-out and delivery services useful to touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states: 'Whether you're vegetarian or have food allergies, we have plenty of delicious menu choices to choose from. Be sure to ask about our gluten-free menu for Kamloops diners.'
